title: Escaping the police by dragon
description: A dragon carries me over the harbour while squad cars keep pace on the wet streets below, searchlights swinging up through the smoke. It breathes fire down the avenue and nobody driving looks up.

title: Eggs rolling through midtown
description: Speckled eggs the height of the buildings come down the avenue and everyone runs the same direction I do. One of them grinds against a taxi and the shell holds.

title: Falling with no ground below
description: I fall backwards through flat grey light with both hands open, and nothing rushes past because there is nothing to pass. The light below keeps getting darker and I keep not arriving.

title: Lying in the grass
description: I lie on my back in clover while the sun comes up behind a city on the far ridge. The grass goes on growing past my ears and I decide not to get up.

title: The seagull wears a badge
description: A seagull in a police vest stands on a rock watching the traffic, and the ones circling above it are wearing caps too. The cable car goes by and nobody on it finds this strange.

title: Running from the investor
description: A man in a suit leans off a moving cable car with a mug in his hand and calls it a quick call. I run downhill past the red bridge and my backpack gets heavier every step.

title: Vegetables eating the forest
description: A carrot, a broccoli and a cabbage taller than the treeline are pulling up pines and eating them roots first. I am standing in the shallow water below where the forest used to be.

title: The cat walks me
description: A tabby the size of a bus walks me down a wet street on a leash while I keep up on my hands and knees. It does not look back once, and the rain never reaches its fur.

title: Sunbathing with an enormous head
description: My head has grown larger than the rest of me and I am on a striped lounger above the sea anyway, sunglasses on, chin up. The drink on the little table stays full all afternoon.
